sf.einnahmenHinweis: Taxes and other revenue; they follow the economy
sf.ausgabenHinweis: Fixed in lira by the budget law, plus interest
sf.plusHinweis: Scope to reduce debt or fund new projects.
sf.jahresrate: Annual rate at current settings, not accumulated treasury cash.
sf.monatsrate: One twelfth of the annual rate, without seasonal variations.
sf.wachstumHinweis: Real growth raises the budget’s purchasing power. Inflation only increases nominal amounts.
sf.rechnungHinweis: Expenditure minus revenue equals the simulation’s deficit. Reforms are shown as a net burden, already offset by additional revenue and savings. Interest is the booked baseline plus extra interest, not a new forecast.
sf.anteileHinweis: Spending is fixed in lira for the budget year. The next budget law plans with the GDP of that time, so unchanged shares grow with the economy from year to year. Revenue follows it within the year, each tax with its own elasticity. Staffing and departmental base budgets overlap and are not added twice. Scale comes from the scenario; the price index is a simplified game model.
sf.geldText: Funds services and investment. Extra spending needs revenue, savings or borrowing.
sf.politikText: Political points measure the effort of reforms and negotiations. They do not pay for schools, salaries or supplies.
sf.zeitText: Attention limits personal decisions. Too many projects lengthen delivery without raising the base political price.
sf.starthilfe: Public money funds departments and investment through revenue or borrowing. Political capital (“Capital” at the top) is needed for reforms and negotiations and grows with support and government work. Attention and administrative capacity limit how much succeeds at once.
sf.preisHinweis: At current economic output; negative amounts ease the budget.
sf.hudTip: Annual financing need: ₺{n} bn. Positive values mean additional borrowing, negative values a surplus. Open the budget to fund departments.
sf.zeile.konjunktur: Tax base: compliance, administration, shadow economy
haushalt.posten.justiz.name: Justice
haushalt.posten.justiz.text: Courts, court offices and training. Funding improves capacity; independence requires separate reforms.
haushalt.posten.justiz.verlierer: Other departments if funded by cuts
haushalt.posten.justiz.kehrseite: Additional recurring spending; money alone does not prevent political interference.
haushalt.posten.justiz.wirkung: Each step builds judicial capacity over twelve months, supporting legal certainty and trust.
haushalt.posten.diplomatie.name: Diplomatic service
haushalt.posten.diplomatie.text: Embassies, consulates and negotiating teams. Better resources support diplomatic engagement.
haushalt.posten.diplomatie.verlierer: Other departments if funded by cuts
haushalt.posten.diplomatie.kehrseite: Recurring costs; additional funding does not automatically end sanctions or wars.
haushalt.posten.diplomatie.wirkung: Each step strengthens reputation and EU relations over nine months.
sf.berichtStand: As of {datum}, annualised: revenue ₺{ein} bn, net expenditure ₺{aus} bn, financing need ₺{kredit} bn. These are saved historical figures; negative financing means a surplus.
sf.beschlussGeld: Direct fiscal effect of this decision: ₺{n} bn of additional annual financing at the economic output then. Negative values ease the budget.
sf.schuldenHeute: Current stock: ₺{betrag} bn ({quote}% of GDP). A stock is not divided by twelve.
sf.schuldenBelegText: Saved monthly settlement: GDP ₺{vorher} → {nachher} bn. Growth and prices change the debt ratio, not the nominal opening stock. Later individual decisions, including those on settlement day, affect the current stock but not this record.
sf.restText: The surplus after full repayment remains in the treasury for later expenditure.
sf.schuldenNochOffen: The first monthly settlement is still pending. No past record is invented for older saves.
sf.schuldenPrognose: Calculated change next month: {wert} percentage points, with the current budget, growth and prices and an unchanged exchange rate. New events are not forecast.
sf.schuldenFlussText: One twelfth of the annual overall deficit ratio. Interest is already included and is not added again.
sf.schuldenBipText: Real growth and prices compound monthly. The changing GDP denominator changes the ratio without repaying nominal debt.
sf.zinsAenderung: Change from debt stock and average interest rate
sf.zinsText: The monthly entry replaces baseline interest with the debt ratio times the smoothed average interest rate. Individual costs incurred since the last entry affect the next one.
sf.konjunkturDefizit: Extra revenue from better compliance, administration and a smaller shadow economy reduces the deficit; a weaker tax base increases it. The business cycle works through the line “Deviation caused by the economy”.
sf.kasseRegel: Surpluses repay debt first. Remaining cash funds later expenditure before new borrowing. This nominal, non-interest-bearing balance is separate from central-bank foreign reserves.
sf.kasseBeleg: Treasury cash in the settled month: {vorher} → {nachher} bn ₺.
sf.restAltText: This older settlement only reported the surplus. No cash balance was saved at that time and none is credited retroactively.
starthilfe.ereignisse: Events demand an answer. Whoever stays silent gets the worse outcome; whoever lacks capital can wait deliberately. Every answer shows what it does.
starthilfe.politik: “Policy” shows what helps most with your acute problems right now. A law needs 301 votes; without them you negotiate with the parliamentary groups under “Parliament & laws”.
starthilfe.bereiche: “Society” shows who supports you and what each group wants, “Foreign” the other states and “Research & goals” your programmes for years. The “Desk” collects what is urgent right now. The election is in about {wahl}.
